lines.text: David asks the LORD not to rebuke him in anger, and to heal him because his bones are in agony.
David cries "How long?" and asks the LORD to save him because of the LORD's loving devotion.
David says there is no mention of the LORD in death and asks who can praise Him from Sheol.
David is weary from groaning, drenches his couch with tears every morning, and his eyes fail from grief.
David tells the workers of iniquity to depart, says the LORD rejects his prayer, and says enemies will be disgraced.
